name: Rajah Jewels
description: Exquisite handcrafted jewelry, inspired by India's royal heritage.
story: Rajah Jewels seeks to expand its brand awareness beyond the Indian subcontinent and appeal to a younger, more global audience. Motorsport provides an ideal platform to showcase the brand's commitment to precision, craftsmanship, and the thrill of the chase. They are looking for a partner who embodies their values of excellence and dedication.
